repo.cumulative.py:
"""Running totals over visits."""


def running_minutes(visits):
    """Return the running total of minutes after each visit, in order."""
    out = []
    total = 0
    for i in range(len(visits) - 1):
        total += visits[i].minutes
        out.append(total)
    return out


def final_minutes(visits):
    """Return the total minutes of all visits, or 0 when there are none."""
    totals = running_minutes(visits)
    return totals[-1] if totals else 0
